definitions.explanation: A man's former wife, after a divorce.

examples.japanese: {元妻|もとつま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I got a call from my ex-wife.

examples.japanese: {元妻|もとつま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{円満|えんまん}→円満：17922_enman⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{別|わか}れた→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: I parted on good terms with my ex-wife.

examples.japanese: {元妻|もとつま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{再婚|さいこん}した→再婚する：25476_saikonsuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was a little surprised when a friend told me my ex-wife had remarried.

notes:
The neutral word, used in conversation and in the news. The counterpart is ⟦{元夫|もとおっと}→元夫：33726_motootto⟧ (ex-husband). In casual speech people also say {元嫁|もとよめ}; ⟦{元|もと}カノ→元カノ：29939_motokano⟧ is an ex-girlfriend.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧: wife
- ⟦{元夫|もとおっと}→元夫：33726_motootto⟧: ex-husband
- ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧: divorce
